system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: persona, rules, tools, skills, capabilities, and instructions stay byte-stable inside a session
system_prompt_style.note: Stable prefix plus bounded tail (memory, world state, skills) assembled at runtime.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Read, write, edit, patch, glob, grep, diff, watch, hash, list, archive extract, run approved shell commands
env_context_strategy.note: World state and recalled notes are also injected into the prompt tail; this could arguably be coded as mixed.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: results and state are summarized, not pasted back in full.
context_compaction.note: conversationMaxPairs default 20 drops old tasks; ARIA snapshots clipped to 24k chars.

observation_format.evidence_quote: ordinary web operation uses accessibility / ARIA snapshots clipped to a character budget (24k by default) instead of screenshot-heavy page dumps.
observation_format.note: Vision describe is optional and returns text.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: completions are constrained into a JSON array of tool calls, including the solo case `[{...}]`.
tool_call_format.note: Default is GBNF-constrained JSON array. Native tool_calls are used for cloud providers, and the qwen-openai-compatible kind parses xml tags.

tool_count.note: Many tool families are listed, but no count is given.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: Read, write, edit, patch, glob, grep, diff
edit_primitive.note: Edit semantics are inferred from the tool names.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: Configure MCP servers in `config.json`, and their tools join the same registry as local tools.
tool_schema_source.note: The schema source for built-in tools is not shown; hand_written is a guess.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: Connect external MCP servers; their tools, resources, and prompts join the same registry.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: An agent is a loop: the model picks an action, something runs it, the result feeds back in, and it repeats until the job is done.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: every tool that would change something is refused, with a note telling the agent to present a plan instead.
planning_granularity.note: Plan mode is opt-in; the plan is text, not a stored object.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: it opens a new terminal window with a fresh atomic-agent in the same directory.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: The model chooses actions. Atomic Agent owns the loop, the state, the approvals

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: shell, filesystem writes, patches, archive extraction, process kill, HTTP requests, skill scripts, and untrusted MCP tools are gated by policy.
human_in_loop.note: Four modes are available: default, plan, auto, and bypass.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: conversation, memory, world state, recalled notes, lessons, procedures, and loaded skill bodies are clipped into a predictable prompt budget.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Notes are stored in SQLite + FTS5, optionally paired with embeddings for hybrid recall.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: Durable deferred turns, cron schedules, intervals, webhooks, and agent-created reminders.
state_persistence.note: Sessions are persisted in SQLite. Resume of an interrupted run is not explicit in the evidence.

self_verification.evidence_quote: Atomic Agent owns the loop, the state, the approvals, the traces, the stop conditions, and the failure boundaries.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: loop again until reply, finish, cancel, or a max-step limit.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: loop again until reply, finish, cancel, or a max-step limit.
termination_condition.note: No-progress guard forces a graceful reply.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: so `cache_prompt` and `slot_id` can reuse KV-cache instead of re-encoding the prompt every turn.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: A local-first AI agent that runs the control loop and all state on your machine.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: Secret redaction and per-tool environment filtering are not complete isolation layers.
filesystem_access.note: Writes are approval-gated by rung (workspace vs home).

network_policy.evidence_quote: Skills and shell commands inherit the agent process environment, including `.env` secrets, so anything you run can itself reach the network.

permission_model.evidence_quote: `ctrl+y` approves the call, `ctrl+d` denies, `ctrl+f` grants its category for the session

tracing.evidence_quote: prompts, completions, tool invocations, outcomes, failure categories, votes, and lifecycle events recorded as local NDJSON.

replayability.evidence_quote: `atomic-agent trace replay <sessionId>` compares current stable-prefix hashes against recorded traces.
replayability.note: Replay here is prompt-drift comparison, not action replay.

guardrails.note: Secret redaction is mentioned in traces.

target_domain.evidence_quote: It drives your desktop: browse, read and edit files, run approved shell commands, inspect documents

open_source.evidence_quote: Open source, running on our TurboQuant `llama.cpp`

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: Local `llama-server` by default; OpenAI-compatible, [OpenRouter](https://openrouter.ai), AI/ML API, and Gemini providers when configured
